ns2:course.label: Advanced Documentary Storytelling & Production
ns2:course.description: For students interested in cinema, journalism, or video storytelling, this class offers a chance to expand their production skills by creating a documentary. This class is open to students who have some experience with videography and editing. 4 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Credit not given if credit for JOUR 480 (Advanced Documentary Production) already given. Prerequisite: JOUR 215 or JOUR 240 or JOUR 340 or MACS 150 or MACS 260 or instructor consent.
